event_name: Date 07 July 2018 Time 14:26 2018 BRITISH GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 July 2018 The driver and team representative are required to report to the Stewards at 15:30 in relation to the incident below.
reason: Alleged breach of Article 31.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, car 35 continued on track instead of entering the pit lane when a Red Flag signal was given, as defined in 31.6 at 14:03. The Stewards Tim Mayer Mumtaz Tahincioglu Tom Kristensen Steve Stringwell
rules_referenced: Article 31.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: Doc 24 2018 British Grand Prix Summons Car 35 Sir Continuing On Track After A Red Flag
